name: Heathens can be selected in Island Events/Heathen-Exclusive Events
description: New Believers. Ordinary Heathens can be chosen for the roles of the new island events that allow them, and events written for the Heathens alone (Heathen-Exclusive Events) can happen. A chief, the Retired Chief and the puzzles' Heathens are never chosen. Heathens get the same personal outcomes as your villagers. When only Heathens are in an event, the outcomes for the whole tribe (food, tech points, buildings, goods, research) happen to the Heathens' village instead and change nothing in yours: their lines end "(no effect)". When Heathens and villagers are in an event together, those outcomes reach your tribe as usual. Heathens never count in the Village Statistics, and the Island Events log marks them "Faction: Heathen". Heathens can die, disappear or have a baby in an event, by the Heathens' own rules: a Heathen who dies just disappears from the camp (a Death record, no grave) unless a skeleton row covers them, a camp Heathen is replaced as when one dies of old age (never after The Last Heathen, never a villager who left your tribe), and a baby is only ever two Heathens' and is born a Heathen. A Heathen is never copied or made a Heathen again. Which roles allow Heathens is set per event; the game's own island events are unchanged. The 45 Heathen-Exclusive Events are about the Heathens' own lives: no Heathen's Faith rises from them, nobody dies or leaves, and a Heathen honoring the dead at the encampment goes to the old hovel when "Memorial Actions Can Also Occur at the Heathen Hovel" is installed, or else sits where they are. Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Needs Story / Cheat Upgrades; the Heathen-Exclusive Events also need the Isola Grand Event Collection.** **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.**
output_tag: Heathens can be selected in Island Events/Heathen-Exclusive Events

needs_on.for: the island-event engine that chooses the villagers

behavior_changes: Story / Cheat Upgrades casts an ordinary Heathen (faction set, never roles 12-17, never sick) in a new event's role marked "heathens": "allowed" or "only" while this row is installed; a role marked "only" takes no believer, and without this row nobody, so its event is not offered.

When every villager cast is a Heathen, the event's food, tech points, award, building damage or repair, goods, trades, tech level and whole-village effects are made nowhere: each automatic line says it happens to the Heathens' village (the Isolans' village with Guardians of Isola Rewrite) and ends "(no effect)".

An event's death or disappearance of a cast Heathen goes through "VVFP Heathen Aging.dll" (VvfpHeathenAgingEventGone): a body only with a skeleton row (the statistics' death counter put back), else the activity stopped, the presence byte cleared and a Death record (Cause of Death's VvfpCauseDiedAmongHeathens); then the replacement of a camp Heathen by the Heathen creator 0x46FD20, as for an old-age death.

An event's pregnancy of a cast Heathen goes through the same companion (VvfpHeathenAgingEventPregnancy): the game's conception 0x465E00 with a Heathen father only (the twins counters put back), the mother kept as expecting and aging until the companion's Heathen birth 40 units later (at once for a nursing baby); none once The Last Heathen is solved.
With this row "VVFP Heathen Aging.dll" splices its two sites even with no aging row ticked; then only a Heathen expecting an event's baby ages, until the birth.
More Island Events casts a Heathen only in a role its table names (none yet).

The Heathen-Exclusive Events HE-01..HE-45 (Isola Grand Event Collection, New Believers only; cie-v6-binary.md 46): "at least N graves" read from the game's own count (0x464E90 on 0x5481A8); the encampment's honoring and reflecting started through the hovel patch's own entries (0x494B83, 0x494DF1) when its bytes are in, else "Sitting"; a group of every ordinary Heathen (or N at random), never roles 12-17, never sick.
The Island Events log ends each Heathen's record with "Faction: Heathen" ("Isolan" with Guardians of Isola Rewrite).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: "VVFP Heathen Aging.dll" splices its two sites at run time, after verifying their stock bytes, all or none; the row is otherwise a name in the installed patches' list ("VVFP Installed Patches.txt") that Story / Cheat Upgrades and More Island Events read.
The game's own island events, their text, their villagers and their chances are never changed.
A Heathen never counts in the Village Statistics; the puzzles' Heathens are never chosen.
evidence_status: the casting, the flavor-only effects and the log line pinned in tests/test_heathens_in_island_events.py (emulated), the Heathen-Exclusive Events and their engine pieces in tests/test_heathen_only_events.py (emulated); runtime/player confirmation pending

runtime_detours.routine: the age credit 0x46FE90's faction test `cmp byte [esi+0x1CEC], bl; mov edi, eax; jne` (the Village Statistics rows' form, `jne` 38, accepted too): a believer goes on to the stock add 0x470081; an aging Heathen gets the same units added to +0x1B8C and takes the branch the executable has there (0x47008D, or 0x4700B9 past the Oldest Villager maximum with the statistics); any other Heathen that branch alone
